text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] P1 - gpu-node-23 container restart storm detected. Auto-page to #incidents and @jules-oncall.

jules-oncall: I'm on it. Seeing ~4 containers restart across pod group `dedicated-usw2-rtpool-a`. Suspect huge prefill allocations from one tenant.

tim: confirmed tenant Y sending very large chat payloads. request sample shows ~95k tokens in initial context (tokenizer estimate).

anita: runtime trace from container 0c9a:
```
[2026-07-09T11:02:41Z] ERROR runtime: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation: out of memory
[2026-07-09T11:02:41Z] WARN runtime: attempting allocation of 3.9GiB during prefill
[2026-07-09T11:02:42Z] INFO containerd: process exited with status 137 (oom/killed)
```

leo: node metrics show GPU mem pinned at 100% and host oom_kill events. kube shows CrashLoopBackOff and backoff increase.

pagerduty: paging policy triggered for P1. escalation to infra-leads and platform oncall.

jules-oncall: mitigation plan (immediate):
- cordon gpu-node-23 to prevent new pods. (kubectl cordon)
- add per-tenant prefill hard-cap: `prefill-hardcap-tokens=48k` on route for tenant Y via rt-policy service.
- set per-gpu low-priority eviction for large prefill: enable `prefill-soft-fail` so requests > headroom return 429 with reason `prefill_too_large`.

anita: executing cordon now.

anita: (cmd) `kubectl cordon gpu-node-23` -> node cordoned. Draining not safe yet while active jobs finishing.

tim: applied rt-policy update: `rtctl set-tenant-limit Y prefill-hardcap=48000`. This will reject new enormous prefill attempts.

leo: observed memory drop on gpu-node-23 from 99% -> 55% within 20s after tenant throttle. No further restarts in the pool.

cs-ops: contacting tenant Y to warn about throttling and to request they chunk large contexts. Drafting message: "We throttled very large context requests to protect shared capacity; please reduce context size or contact your CSM for dedicated sizing."

jules-oncall: short-term follow-ups: 1) keep node cordoned until next maintenance window, 2) add alert for prefill-token-sum per-pod > 2.5GiB, 3) implement graceful prefill pre-check in runtime to return structured error instead of OOM.

anita: will open INF ticket INF-2026-045 with timeline and logs.

tim: quick dev note: I'll open a PR to add prefill headroom check gate in the allocation path; will include opt-in config for Dedicated pools. Aim for canary tomorrow.

pagerduty: incident acknowledged and mitigated state = partial-mitigated. Awaiting confirmation from CS and stability for 45min.

cs-ops: tenant Y confirmed degraded requests; they accepted temporary throttling and will change integration to chunk. They asked for ETA on fix.

jules-oncall: ETA for runtime gate PR to canary = 24h. Postmortem to follow with permanent limits and better tenant accounting.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] Mitigation steps applied: cordon, tenant prefill hardcap, soft-fail enabled. Monitoring stable for 10m.

jules-oncall: assigning owners: tim -> prefill gate PR, leo -> node restart alert, anita -> INF ticket + customer timeline, cs-ops -> customer comms.

anita: saving logs to incident page, will update INF ticket once cordon removed.

jules-oncall: closing active page for now; will reopen if restarts resume. Full RCA and timeline to be published in INF-2026-045 within 72h. :memo:
